title: Federal Reserve Board - Statement Regarding Monetary Policy Implementation and Balance Sheet Normalization
主要内容: On January 30, 2019, the Federal Reserve Board issued a statement regarding its monetary policy implementation and balance sheet normalization. The statement outlines the central bank's approach to adjusting monetary policy and managing its balance sheet in response to economic conditions. The Committee emphasized its intention to continue operating in a regime where an ample supply of reserves ensures control over short-term interest rates through administered rates, without requiring active management of reserve supply. The Federal Reserve Board stated that changes in the target range for the federal funds rate remain its primary tool for adjusting monetary policy. The Committee is prepared to adjust balance sheet normalization details based on economic and financial developments. It also emphasized readiness to use its full range of tools, including altering the size and composition of its balance sheet, if more accommodative monetary policy is needed beyond rate reductions.
